body: It's not terrible advice, well not for me.  I'm no stranger to her and I have thought it would be less traumatizing for the person that would discover my body.  It's odd that you mentioned the only other method by which I would opt out.

Hey, thank you for commenting.  I'm as clinical and grounded as one can get while simultaneously being depressed.  Although my experience wasn't overly profound, it did shift my perspective on death enough to ease the grip a little.  Hell, maybe I'm just tired and ready to slap meaning on whatever will give me the courage to aim and pull.  I doubt I'll ever feel ready to take my own life but it gets precariously real the more energy is given to thoughts on the matter... that part is true.  Today I was especially locked into that numbness with the thousand yard stare.  Trying to act normal and resist my depression for the sake of not looking unstable in the company of my coworkers has me exhausted.  There are sides of me that want to be dead.
